branding.font_note: Font stack "Helvetica for Target", HelveticaForTarget, Targetica, "HelveticaNeue for Target", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif. Body text #333333 on white. Headings bold; search-results h1 is the query in lowercase. Primary CTA (Preorder / Add to cart) is bold white text on #CC0000 with a fully rounded 999px pill radius, full width of the buy box. Secondary buttons ("View cart & check out", "Save for later", PayPal) are white pills with a dark gray border (variant "outlined"). Search field sits in a light gray #F7F7F7 rounded bar with a red circular search button. Logo link color #666666 (icon fill rendered black/red). Success states use a green checkmark icon (Added to cart, Free shipping row); warnings use orange-dark text ("Preorders sold out").

Row 2 (main): red bullseye logo (link "Target home") | primary nav "Categories" (hamburger / Main menu link to /c/shop-all-categories/-/N-5xsxf), "Deals", "Pickup & delivery" | centered search box placeholder "What can we help you find?" with mic icon ("search by voice"), clear ("reset") and red round submit ("search"), plus an "Ask Target" button | right: person icon "Account, sign in" (link /account) and cart icon with count badge "cart 0 items" (link /cart). Footer email capture: "Get top deals, latest trends, and more." with a "Sign up" button. Checkout pages use a reduced header (logo only, data-test header-tgtLogo).

product_page.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI - PlayStation 5 (Code in Box, Delivers 11/12/26, Playable 11/19/26)
product_page.price_display: Single bold price "$79.99" in the price module under the rating row; no strikethrough, no list price, no member price. Target's price API (pdp_client_v1) returns only formatted_current_price "$79.99" with price type "reg" for both TCINs, and the price module (price-v2) renders server-supplied rows only — so there is NO Target Circle Card 5% line under the price for this item. Re-verified 2026-09-30: the price-v2 chunk contains only "More info about pricing" / "Pricing details", and none of the 236 JS chunks of the product-page app contain a "Save 5%" / "with Target Circle Card" price string (the only 5% strings are the birthday-gift and Circle 360 subscription copy). The only Circle Card wording in the buy box is the Shipping tab's ships-free line, which for cardholders renders "Ships free with your" + the Target Circle™ Card logo. What the API does supply for the buy box: financing cells — Affirm "4 interest-free payments or as low as $15/mo" / "With Affirm" and PayPal "Pay in 4" / "Pay in 4 interest-free payments of $20.00" (is_finance_eligible true; note Target's Affirm details drawer lists "Preorders" among items not eligible for Affirm) — plus an add-on "2 Year Video Games Protection Plan ($75-$99.99) - Allstate" at $13.00. A "More info about pricing" / "Pricing details" info link belongs to the price module.

fulfillment_options.label: Pickup
fulfillment_options.detail: Fulfillment API (store 3410 Scotts Valley, ZIP 95065): order_pickup UNAVAILABLE, in_store_only UNAVAILABLE, ship_to_store UNAVAILABLE at the selected store; backup store Marina (2306) reports order_pickup PRE_ORDER_SELLABLE with pickup_date 2026-11-12 and a 120-minute pick SLA. Target help: "We're testing Order Pickup and Drive Up options for select preorder items and at select stores for release date pickup." Tab strings in Target's code: unavailable store → "Not available" with a "Check other stores" link; available pre-order store → green "Ready on release date" (or "Ready on <date>") under "Pick up at <store>" + "Change"; excluded items → "Not eligible for Order Pickup"; store status labels "In stock", "Limited stock", "Out of stock", "Not sold at this store". Tab-subtitle logic verified 2026-09-30 from chunk 68009 of the PDP app: the Pickup tab's subtitle is the pickup promise ("Ready on release date" / "Ready on <date>" for pre-orders, "Ready within 2 hours" for stock items) when the selected store can fulfil, "Pick it up <date>" for in-store-only items, otherwise "Not available" — so at Scotts Valley this item's Pickup tab reads "Not available" (medium-high confidence: API data from 2026-09-29 plus current code, not seen rendered). Release-date Order Pickup / Drive Up for this pre-order is therefore offered only at select stores (e.g. Marina: "Ready on release date").

fulfillment_options.label: Delivery
fulfillment_options.detail: Same Day Delivery (Shipt). Fulfillment API: scheduled_delivery UNAVAILABLE at store 3410 for this item; Target help lists "Select electronics & video games" among items not available for Same Day Delivery. Tab-subtitle logic verified 2026-09-30 (chunk 68009): with a delivery address set, the subtitle is "As soon as <first window>" when Same Day Delivery is available, otherwise "Find it nearby" (a nearby store has it) or "Not available"; with no delivery address (a typical guest) it reads "Check availability". For this item the guest sees "Check availability" or, after entering an address, "Not available" (medium-high confidence). Same Day Delivery is not offered for this pre-order. Fee from API pay_per_order_charges: scheduled_delivery $9.99 (one_day $7.99); free with Target Circle 360 on $35+.

fulfillment_options.label: Shipping
fulfillment_options.detail: Fulfillment API: shipping_options availability_status PRE_ORDER_SELLABLE, service STANDARD ("Standard Shipping"), min/max delivery date 2026-11-12, cutoff 2026-09-30T14:00Z. Verified 2026-09-30 from the PDP bundles: the Shipping tab's subtitle reads "Preorder" for a PRE_ORDER_SELLABLE item (chunk 68009 returns "Preorder" before any arrival-date text; other items get "Arrives <date>" / "Not available"). The selected Shipping cell (data-test @web/AddToCart/Fulfillment/PreorderSellable) shows the heading "Preorder for 95065" with an "Edit ZIP code" link, then in green "Release date: <date>" and in gray "Delivered on or shortly after release date" (when no release date is known the green line itself reads "Delivered on or shortly after release date"), then the ships-free line: "Ships free with [Target Circle 360 logo] or $35 orders" for guests, "Ships free with $35 orders", "Ships free with your [Target Circle™ Card logo]" for cardholders or "Ships free with your [Circle 360 logo] membership" for members. "Arrives on or shortly after release date" is the pre-order arrival string used for cart/checkout item groups. Free standard shipping on $35+ (or with Target Circle Card / Circle 360), otherwise $5.99. Item cannot ship to PO Boxes, Alaska, Hawaii or US territories.

cta_buttons.label: Preorder
cta_buttons.behavior: Verified from Target's production add-to-cart bundle: pre-order items render the PREORDER_BUYABLE button — text "Preorder", aria-label "Preorder <title>", data-test preorderButton, primary red filled pill, full width — with the Pickup intent using PREORDER_ORDER_PICKUP_BUYABLE (same "Preorder" text). Clicking adds the item to the cart and opens the "Added to cart" modal; the header badge becomes "cart 1 item". Disabled variant keeps the text "Preorder". Sold-out variant is plain orange text "Preorders sold out" with "Check back on release date" under a "Coming Thu, Nov 12" / "Coming soon" heading and a "Sign in to get notified" option (notify_me_eligible true). Non-pre-order items read "Add to cart". Re-verified 2026-09-30 in the PDP app chunk _app-caf4a0027094e71e.js (PREORDER_BUYABLE → text "Preorder", aria "Preorder {title}", data-test preorderButton; PREORDER_ORDER_PICKUP_BUYABLE → data-test preorderOrderPickupButton). The PDP renders it through AddToCartButtonForProductContext with isQuantityPicker: true, i.e. the Qty dropdown sits in the same flex row to the left of the button. Still not seen rendered (press-and-hold bot check on 2026-09-30 too).

This item's purchase_limit is 2, so the options are 1 and 2. Feature flag GLOBAL_ADD_TO_CART_QUANTITY_STEPPER_ENABLED is true, so after adding, the button can turn into a −/+ quantity stepper (observed in code, not rendered).

add_to_cart.contents: Verified 2026-09-30 from Target's production PDP bundles (_app chunk: AddToCartDrawerContent + ModalHeadingAddedToCart; lazy chunks component-add-to-cart-ModalContentAddToCartSuccess and …SuccessV1): clicking "Preorder" opens Target's add-to-cart drawer (the code consistently calls the container a drawer — closeAddToCartDrawer, SUPPRESS_CART_SUCCESS_DRAWER, nicollet type "drawer" — i.e. a panel that slides in from the right on desktop and up from the bottom on small screens; geometry medium confidence, contents high). Heading: a 24px green checkmark icon followed by "Added to cart". Body, in order: the added item card (image + title), a gray line "Edit delivery method in cart", an orange "This item only ships with $35 orders." line for add-on items only, an "Available deals" block with Target Circle offer checkboxes when offers apply (toast "Check the box to get the savings!"), a protection-plan (Allstate) offer card when the item is ESP-eligible (this game is: the $13.00 2-year plan), then two stacked full-width pills — primary (red) "Continue shopping", which closes the drawer, and outlined "View cart & check out", which links to /cart — followed by a recommendations carousel keyed to the added TCIN. Target help confirms the two choices as "view cart & check out" or "continue shopping". Error heading: "Item not added to cart". The header cart badge increments ("cart 1 item").

auth.screen_text: Target help: "You'll need to sign in to a Target account in order to proceed with checkout." and "A Target account is required to place an order in the Target app or on Target.com." The sign-in page (title "Login: Target") offers email + password, "Sign in with passkey" (Face ID / fingerprint / device PIN) or a phone-number verification code, and a "Create your Target account" link. No guest option. The cart's own button for guests reads "Sign in to check out".

steps.notes: Mandatory; there is no guest path. Password rules for new accounts: 8–20 characters with 2 of lowercase/uppercase/numbers/special (no <>).

steps.notes: Field labels, headings and the "Save & continue" label verified from Target's checkout bundle and re-verified 2026-09-30 from the current build (chunks 667, 6793, pages/checkout): the step heading is "Shipping address" (or "Address" when Target's single-address drawer flag is on; "Home address" with "Used to calculate any applicable tax" for digital-only orders); fields First name / Last name / Address line 1 / Address line 2 (optional) / Zip code / City / State / Phone number / Set as default address / Delivery instructions (optional); the address form's submit button is "Save & continue" ("Save" when editing an existing address). Checkout is one page: each step is a container with active/pending states (data-test STEP_SHIPPING_CONTAINER etc.) that pushes its own /checkout/<step> URL. Address line 1 has typeahead suggestions; validation shows "Verify your address" with "Use verified address" / "Use unverified address" / "Use selected address", or errors such as "Check your ZIP code and try again.", "Double-check your unit info and try again.", "Can't ship to your address". Toasts: "Shipping address added" / "updated" / "removed". Changing the shipping address during checkout forces CVV re-entry (Target help). A collapsed "Cart" items accordion sits above the steps.

The "physical" listing is Code in Box — a download code, no disc. The title itself carries "(Code in Box, Delivers 11/12/26, Playable 11/19/26)": Target's street date is Nov 12 (pre-load) while the game unlocks Nov 19.

Only the Standard edition is sold; no Ultimate or Collector's edition on Target (Ultimate is digital-only through platform stores). A GTA VI limited-edition DualSense controller ($84.99, Preorder, release date Thu, Nov 19) sits beside the game in search.

Pre-order charge model: authorization hold at order, a new hold 7 days before street date, full charge on ship; price invoiced at shipment; "Request cancellation" is available in order details until the item processes for shipping.
Shipping restriction on this item: no PO Boxes, Alaska, Hawaii or US territories.

Bot detection (HUMAN Security / PerimeterX enforcer script): an automated browser hit a "Quick verification — Press & hold to confirm you're a human (and not a bot)" interstitial on the PDP on 2026-09-29 and again on 2026-09-30 (when the search page also came back degraded: empty query, "We couldn’t find a match for your search."); the buy box stays as skeleton placeholders behind it. Search tile CTA reads "Preorder" for pre-orders versus "Choose Options" / "Add to cart" for other tiles; the heart icon is labeled "sign in to favorite".

Cart holds up to 99 items and adding does not reserve stock ("Your cart is already full…", "The maximum quantity of this item has already been added to your cart."); orders mixing Target, Target Plus Partner and Same Day Delivery items split into separate order numbers and confirmation emails.
Changing the shipping address during checkout forces re-entry of the card CVV.
Signed-in Circle offers (e.g. a 20% student/teacher offer seen Aug 2026 bringing the game to $63.99) apply at checkout.
Affirm financing cells appear under the price, but Target's Affirm details list "Preorders" among items not eligible for Affirm.

The add-to-cart confirmation is a drawer, not a redirect to the cart, and its red primary button is "Continue shopping" — "View cart & check out" is the outlined secondary.
